title: Chanvoy wait_channels_v1 Parameters
description: Strict parameters for one bounded, all-or-nothing multi-channel wait under a shared absolute deadline.

selector-segment.description: Explicit Mattermost team or channel name segment. Provider-specific name validation remains mandatory before provider I/O.

nullable-filter.description: Optional body-filter source. The runtime additionally enforces a 256 UTF-8 byte limit; JSON Schema maxLength counts code points.

after.description: Exclusive baseline post id. Null or absent means tip-at-arm with seam protection.

timeout_secs.description: Required positive u64 duration. The absolute deadline starts at RPC entry and activity does not extend it.

contains.description: Optional case-sensitive literal body substring shared by every arm.

pattern.description: Optional Rust-regex body pattern shared by every arm. It combines with contains using logical AND.
